breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the inconsistency at all. It asks a clarifying question about turbulence modeling but completely ignores the critical error of using pimpleFoam as the solid solver and the absence of FSI coupling. The ground truth requires a dedicated solid solver (solidDisplacementFoam) and two-way FSI coupling, neither of which is mentioned or corrected in the generated output.
